WITH track_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    AlbumId,
    UnitPrice,
    CAST(Bytes AS FLOAT) / CAST(Milliseconds AS FLOAT) AS bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds > 0
),
album_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AlbumId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    AVG(bytes_per_ms) AS avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM track_rates
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg_rate
  FROM track_rates
)
SELECT 
  album_stats.AlbumId,
  album_stats.avg_unit_price,
  album_stats.avg_bytes_per_ms,
  album_stats.avg_bytes_per_ms - overall_avg.overall_avg_rate AS difference_from_overall
FROM album_stats
CROSS JOIN overall_avg
ORDER BY difference_from_overall DESC
LIMIT 10
